primary_source: William Lilly Christian Astrology 1647 original Wellcome b30338724
heading: If have Brethren or Sisters
scope: Original historical speculative sibling/fertility classifications; no actual person fertility or family-size prediction validation.

groups.source_group: Original numbered CHAP CXVIII firstborn to individual significators

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CXVIII If have Brethren or Sisters
claims.historical_meaning: This numbered question begins after the unnumbered third-house introduction, on original PDF598.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Significators of Brethren and Sisters in every Nativity
claims.historical_meaning: The author now specifies sibling-indicator factors to examine in each nativity, distinct from the introduction's first-born preference.

groups.source_group: Three named source factors including cusp geometry and planets

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: third house from five degrees preceding the cusp
claims.historical_meaning: The relevant third-house zone is described as starting five degrees before its cusp, requiring exact historical house boundaries.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: until five degrees of the succeeding house
claims.historical_meaning: Its other endpoint is stated relative to the succeeding house's cusp, with mathematical inclusivity unspecified.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Lord of the third house
claims.historical_meaning: The ruler of the third house is an explicit source factor for the question.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Planet or Planets intercepted therein, if any be
claims.historical_meaning: The author adds planets intercepted in the third, conditionally when such planets exist.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Mars a generall Significator of Brethren
claims.historical_meaning: Mars is named as a general indicator of brothers; this is period astrology, not a validated sex or sibling predictor.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon of Sisters
claims.historical_meaning: The Moon is named as a general indicator of sisters; it is not evidence of biological sex in real families.

groups.source_group: All or majority fruitful versus barren and mixed conditions

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: all these Significators or the greater part
claims.historical_meaning: The original permits a majority, not exclusively all, of the named indicators to support a conclusion.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: fruitfull Planets
claims.historical_meaning: Fruitful planets are a named property of the natal indicators used in the alleged sibling-number rule.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: posited in prolificall Signes
claims.historical_meaning: Those planets must also lie in prolific zodiac signs for the full many-siblings case.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: discerne many Brethren and Sisters
claims.historical_meaning: The author alleges a high sibling count for the compound fruitful condition, with no numerical definition of 'many'.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: barren Planets and in barren Signes
claims.historical_meaning: The opposite claim combines barren planets with barren zodiac signs rather than only one or the other.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: few or none at all
claims.historical_meaning: A barren configuration allegedly predicts few siblings or none, without prospective empirical measurement.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: barren Planet in fruitfull Signe, or on the contrary
claims.historical_meaning: Opposite planet/sign classifications create a mixed prediction category rather than a strict yes/no.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: but a small number or a meannesse
claims.historical_meaning: The mixed case is assigned relatively few or moderate siblings, without an exact count.

groups.source_group: Testimony number and strength as a grading rule

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: according to the number of Significators
claims.historical_meaning: The author weighs how many sources contribute fruitful versus barren testimony.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: and their potency
claims.historical_meaning: Their stated planetary strength adjusts the count inference, with no reproducible numeric weights in this passage.

groups.source_group: Fruitful barren and node planet classification

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Fruitfull or Prolificall Planets Jupiter and Venus
claims.historical_meaning: The two traditional benefics Jupiter and Venus are the primary alleged fruitful planets.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: some do adde ... one of the lunar Nodes
claims.historical_meaning: The author says some astrologers also add the node indicated by a glyph, rather than treating this extra choice as mandatory.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: being of the nature of Jupiter and Venus
claims.historical_meaning: The optional node is classified as resembling Jupiter/Venus in the historical rule.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Sterill or barren Planets are Saturn and Mars
claims.historical_meaning: Saturn and Mars are named as traditional barren planets, not actual reproductive causes.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: as also the other lunar Node
claims.historical_meaning: The opposite lunar node is added to the traditional barren category, a glyph that warrants verification.

groups.source_group: Sun Moon Mercury nuanced fertility signification

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: The Luminaries shew a mediocrity
claims.historical_meaning: Sun and Moon are grouped around an intermediate outcome instead of two extreme classes.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Sun more neer to Barrennesse ... excesse of heat
claims.historical_meaning: The source places Sun nearer barren status using premodern heat physiology; this is not biology.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon ... most by nature ... more fruitfull
claims.historical_meaning: The Moon is considered more fruitful than barren, another period claim without demographic evidence.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Mercury is indifferent
claims.historical_meaning: Mercury is presented as a conditional/neutral indicator rather than intrinsically fruitful or barren.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: plurality where joyned with fruitfull Planets
claims.historical_meaning: Mercury allegedly favors greater numbers when configured with the fruitful class.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: contrary when posited with barren
claims.historical_meaning: Mercury allegedly supports the inverse result when related to barren planets, preserving the conditional reversal.

groups.source_group: Ordered aspect hierarchy and partile dominance

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Conjunction preferred before Trine
claims.historical_meaning: Lilly prefers conjunction over trine in this particular family-size inference.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Trine before Sextile
claims.historical_meaning: The author ranks trine above sextile, contrary to any unconditional averaging of aspects.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Sextile before Square
claims.historical_meaning: Sextile is preferred over square as testimony of the indicated planet's class.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Square before Opposition
claims.historical_meaning: Square outranks opposition, completing a five-aspect priority chain.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Partill aspect before a Platick
claims.historical_meaning: A partile/exact aspect is preferred over a wider platick aspect; the exact orb threshold remains unstated.

groups.source_group: Aries Taurus Gemini historical birth/fertility sign classifications

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Aries ... Mars a sterill Planet ... Sun Exaltation
claims.historical_meaning: Aries is presented as relatively barren due to traditional Mars rulership and Sun exaltation.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Taurus ... more fruitfull ... Venus and Moon
claims.historical_meaning: Taurus is classified as relatively fruitful, attributed to Venus domicile and Moon exaltation.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Gemini ... barren ... house of Mercury
claims.historical_meaning: Gemini is classified as barren in the source on account of Mercury's domicile and its claimed self-indifference.

groups.source_group: Cancer through Pisces historical sign classification with exceptions

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Cancer is a fruitfull Signe ... Moon ... exaltation of Jupiter
claims.historical_meaning: Cancer is classified as fruitful using Moon domicile and Jupiter exaltation in the period text.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Leo reputed barren ... Lions bring forth Young rarely
claims.historical_meaning: Leo is called barren with an animal-analogy rationale rather than evidence about human family size.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Virgo name of a barren Signe ... Mayds
claims.historical_meaning: Virgo is categorized barren through historical virgin/maiden imagery, not human reproductive evidence.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Libra rather a Signe of fecundity ... Venus and Saturn
claims.historical_meaning: Libra is considered relatively fruitful despite Saturn exaltation, a mixed dignity rationale.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Scorpio though house of Mars ... generally accepted fruitfull
claims.historical_meaning: Scorpio is declared fruitful despite Mars rulership, a clear exception to a ruler-only algorithm.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Sagittarius ever conceived fruitfull ... Jupiter
claims.historical_meaning: Sagittarius is held fruitful, historically attributed to Jupiter domicile.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Capricorn Signe of few children inclining to barrennesse
claims.historical_meaning: Capricorn is classed as few-children/barren, but source offers no numeric birth-count threshold.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Aquarius without doubt more fruitfull then barren
claims.historical_meaning: Aquarius is assigned more fruitful than barren rather than an absolute category.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Pisces very fecund ... house of Jupiter and exaltation of Venus
claims.historical_meaning: Pisces is described as extremely fruitful and associated with many children under Jupiter/Venus dignities.
